capabilities: Render task-list items as tiles under heading lanes
Reorder tiles and lanes by drag or arrow keys
Check, archive or delete tiles from the keyboard
Open existing obsidian-kanban boards in place
Edit dates, times and tags from a mobile toolbar
extras: Keeps obsidian-kanban markers until a board is upgraded, so reverting stays possible; backs writes with a backup, undo/redo and overwrite protection; CJK guarantees documented in CJK.md; beta builds via BRAT; MIT, clean-room rewrite.
intentEvidence: Boards from the (GPL, now-unmaintained) obsidian-kanban just open
motivation: The author first wrote plugins for obsidian-kanban, then rebuilt the whole table from scratch because patching someone else's plugin was harder.
problem: Reordering tasks in a Markdown note means editing text by hand, and existing kanban boards are awkward with a keyboard, on phones, or with CJK input.

relations.evidence: Boards from the (GPL, now-unmaintained) obsidian-kanban just open

summary: Card-table board view that turns a Markdown note's task-list items into draggable tiles arranged under heading lanes.
